content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text has multiple defender-cited verses answering Matthew 1:16 and decides the link by whether any text's own words state the contrary, the verse-by-verse stating-verse inquiry K-C retires for a chain.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "the verb change is real [L1]/[L2] but neither text's own words state the other reading's contrary.", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; I read it as (1) requiring the combined chain's support to decide and (2) not allowing a lack of a single verse stating the contrary in its own words to control.", "why": "The judge declares the link underdetermined because no text's own words state the contrary, which is exactly the stating-verse test K-C says is retired instead of weighing the chain by footing."}
